decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION-BRANCH READ (owner decision 184; level 2; claim ceiling 'nominated', ruling O1). Per branch (a-agree delivering, b-depth, t-twin): the sealed branch note's candidate list gives gold's rank (1/2/3/absent), top1 and present offline (gold enters only offline); the branch's level-2 first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (score_complete_derived_copy); A's column is A's own first Solver answer. Every contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929); the utterance-level number is reported beside and never gates. (1) THE TWIN NULL: T minus A per metric; the bar = |T - A offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the design's own provisional floor per metric (owner decision 190; stage3_measurement.provisional_floor_pp -- intent 0.6500 pp, SLU 1.4900 pp). (2) PRESENCE: b-depth minus A on gold-on-list (present) in the branch note (primary, ruling O4). NOMINATED (as a presence change) iff the present CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds the twin's present bar. Reported beside, never gating: official intent accuracy and SLU-F1 of the level-2 branch Solver column (B vs A vs T), list size, gold rank, and the conversion of gold at rank 3. A presence nomination opens no system claim: it only informs a later level-2 intent cell on the same pair.
